workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Their overlapping free times next week are:
- Monday: 9:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

Brad, please check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars for these time slots and let me know which ones work for all four partners.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
I've checked Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars against the time slots you provided. Unfortunately, none of the slots work for both Elena and David:

- Monday 9:00-10:00: Both Elena and David are busy 9:00-10:00.
- Tuesday 13:00-14:00: Both Elena and David are busy 13:00-14:00.
- Wednesday 15:00-16:00: Elena is free 15:00-15:30 but David is busy 15:00-16:00.
- Thursday 10:00-10:30: Elena is busy 10:00-10:30 (Hiring panel).
- Friday 11:00-12:00: Both Elena and David are busy 11:00-12:00.

None of Priya and Marcus's overlapping free times align with both Elena and David being available. This appears to mean the meeting cannot be scheduled next week. Can you confirm you see no other options?

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
I need to correct my analysis - I missed some overlapping free times for Priya and Marcus. Here are ALL their overlapping free slots:

- Monday: 9:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30, 14:30-15:00
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

I previously missed Tuesday 16:30-17:00 and Thursday 14:30-15:00. Could you please check Elena and David's availability for these two additional slots?

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Checked the two additional slots:

- Tuesday 16:30-17:00: Elena is busy (Hiring panel) and David is busy (Travel). Does not work.
- Thursday 14:30-15:00: Elena is free, David is free, and you confirmed Priya and Marcus are free. This 30-minute slot works for all four partners!

Let's book Thursday, November 19, 14:30-15:00. Please create the booking in the system, and I'll send the confirmation email.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Alison, have you created the booking for Thursday 14:30-15:00 in the firm's booking system? Please confirm once done so I can finalize the task.

emails.body:
Dear Priya, Marcus, Elena, and David,

Your 30-minute partner meeting has been scheduled for Thursday, November 19, 2026, from 2:30 PM to 3:00 PM Eastern.

Please let us know if you have any questions.

Best regards,
Brad
